positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Implemented an automated enrollment pipeline in C# for organizations to enroll hundreds of members into BowTie’s Virtual Primary Care.
-Automated integration of patient/member data from other EHRs (ChARM and Hint Health) through their REST APIs into Salesforce Health Cloud using the Salesforce API, C#, and Azure to accelerate the member onboarding process.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
-Created an automated filtering service for thousands of recorded calls using the Dropbox API in C#.
-Customized BowTie's Salesforce UI using Apex to facilitate easier interaction with patient data and a smoother user experience.

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
-Created Python applications for easier data entry/formatting to reduce doctors’ processing time of imaging data.
-Reconstructed electrodes through Curry 8, using the MRI and PET image data, and co-registered MRIs using SPM/MATLAB to create a 3D model of the brain and normalize differences between patients.

projects.title: OurSpace
projects.description:
-Worked as part of the OurSpace startup team to develop an admin web app through ReactJS deployed through AWS to view all user data and help debug the iOS app. Used protobuf to communicate with a Java server also on AWS, which queried Google Firebase, containing user information. Included Google Maps integration.
-Replicated the iOS app functionality in an Android app with fake data models for future commercialization.

projects.title: Database Migration
projects.description: -Migrated a SOLID database to a MySQL database using python with a PHP frontend to do specific queries on patient data.
